description: Labeled intent-extraction cases: a natural-language/spoken phrasing and the structured fields it should produce. Numbers are graded exactly; features as a case-insensitive set. These exercise the Gemini 'understand' layer end-to-end against the running backend; they skip gracefully if the model is unavailable (free-tier 503).

cases.name: canonical monitor request with word-number budget
cases.transcript: I need five 27 inch monitors for our analytics team, keep the total under twelve hundred dollars, they must have USB-C and at least a three year warranty

cases.name: digits budget and features list
cases.transcript: buy 3 USB-C monitors with HDMI, budget 900, two year warranty minimum

cases.name: 4K requirement and larger size
cases.transcript: get me two 32 inch 4K monitors under 800 dollars each is fine so up to 1600 total, USB-C required

cases.name: no explicit quantity defaults to one
cases.transcript: I want a 27 inch USB-C monitor with a 3 year warranty under 300 dollars

cases.name: ten units larger budget
cases.transcript: we need ten monitors, 27 inch, USB-C, total budget of two thousand five hundred, warranty at least 3 years

cases.name: no feature requirement
cases.transcript: I just need four cheap 24 inch monitors under 600 dollars total
